question:
For any real number $x$, let $[x]$ denote the largest integer which is less than or equal to $x$. Let $N_2=3$, $N_3=5$, $N_4=6,\ldots$ be the sequence of non-square positive integers. If the $n$th non-square positive integer satisfies $m^2<N_n<(m+1)^2$, then show that
\[
m=\left[\sqrt n+\frac12\right].
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
